# Failure-aware evidence fusion

::: {.hub-idea-hero}
<p class="hub-idea-status">Idea · High priority · 2/9 readiness fields complete</p>

## What does this mean?

Use a reliability check to choose which evidence sources should influence each request.
:::

## Why does it matter?

Response and reference evidence help unevenly, so a fixed mixture can hide failures.

## How does it work?

<ol class="hub-process hub-record-path">
<li class="hub-process-step">Read the new request and estimate which evidence sources are dependable.</li>
<li class="hub-process-step">Choose a bounded evidence mixture using the frozen reliability rule.</li>
<li class="hub-process-step">Rank candidates and compare with the frozen dense/profile control.</li>
</ol>
